title: Vegetarian Bistek
description: A vegetarian twist on the classic Filipino dish, bistek. Marinated portobello mushrooms are grilled to perfection and served with a side of savory gooey sauce.
instructions: Marinate the portobello mushrooms in a mixture of olive oil, savory soy sauce, bistek seasoning, and garlic powder for at least 30 minutes.
Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Remove the mushrooms from the marinade, letting any excess liquid drip off.
Grill the mushrooms for 3-4 minutes per side, or until they're tender and slightly charred.
Serve the grilled mushrooms with a side of gooey sauce for dipping.
Optional: Serve with steamed vegetables or a side salad for a complete meal.
